title: 第6901章 阴天子的悔意第6900章 无上剑道神通
slug: 剑帝第6901章阴天子的悔意
lines: 别看地府的强者数量远多于炎黄龙庭，可在混沌级别的宝物上，就有着极大的欠缺了。
最为重要的原因是，地府将用于孕育混沌级别宝物的混沌本源，孕育出了果位。
类似这等果位的功效十分明显，那就是果位加身，任何生灵都能够轻易蜕变成至强者。
只要果位尚在，完全不需要担心地府的强者出现断代的问题。
因为在阴天子眼中，人定胜天。
无论宝物再怎么好，终究乃是死物。
不仅有可能遗失，甚至在强者尽数陨落后，宝物在手也完全发挥不出相对应的威能。
正是如此，祂汇集一切力量孕育了果位。
诸如十方鬼帝，十大阴帅，这些全部都是果位。
每孕育一个果位所付出的代价，不亚于孕育一件混沌级别的宝物。
由此便能看出，地府在果位上的付出，至少相当于二十件混沌级别的宝物。
漫长时间岁月中，凭借着那些果位孕育的强者，地府可以说无往不利。
尤其是轮回连通诸天万界，更能搜罗无穷无尽的强者。
这些强者在果位强者的率领之下，更能够攻占诸天。
一直以来，阴天子对于自己的谋划都十分自得。
万万没有想到，最后却碰到了孙冰的炎黄龙庭。
仰仗着混沌级别的宝物，硬生生挡住了地府的攻势。
这一刻的阴天子，甚至都有些懊悔，若是当时不孕育出那么多果位，反倒是多孕育几个宝物就好了。
只可惜，大帝之下的生灵，尚且还能够通过逆转时间来重新开始。
一旦突破到了大帝，过去，现在乃至于未来三世身融为一体。
这等生灵的任何时候都是当下，没有过去，没有未来，也并不存在回溯的可能。
除非是第五维度中的至高存在，否则根本就不可能扭转过去。
不过此时的阴天子已经下定决心，待到此战过后，定然要耗费混沌本源，孕育一些混沌灵宝。
当务之急还是先解决孙冰等人。
这不仅是因为他们威胁了地府的安危。
还有一个十分重要的原因就是，只要将孙冰等人斩杀，那么是否代表着，能够将青萍剑，开天神斧等诸多至宝收入囊中呢？
仅仅只是想到了这般场景，阴天子等存在的心中都充满着期待。
随即，祂再次操控自身的权柄。
但冥冥中的酆都意志彻底显化。
“轰隆”
阵阵惊雷炸响，无数规则动荡。
原本束缚修罗鬼王的阵法，被浩瀚混沌轻易点破。
两道血色的目光直接跨越了空间落到孙冰身上。
被困在阵法中这么长时间，修罗鬼王心中的杀意无法宣泄，如今已经达到了一种癫狂的程度。
所以刚一脱困，便盯上了孙冰。
虽然修罗冥王剑已经被吞噬，可事到如今，其身上的杀意飙升，无尽的血色杀意汇集。
最后更是在众目睽睽之下，化作了一柄杀戮锋刃。
这并非什么级别的宝物，通体都是无尽的杀意。
以此时修罗鬼王所表现的状态来看，一旦这杀戮锋刃伤到生灵，那么隐藏在其中的无尽杀意，将会瞬间灌输到敌人的体内。
最后甚至能够凭借着那近乎无穷无尽的杀意，硬生生将敌人的神魂破灭。
完全没有任何言语，修罗鬼王出手了。
杀戮锋刃直接挥出。
content_en:
Although there are far more powerful people in the underworld than Yanhuang Longting, there is a huge lack of treasures at the chaos level.
The most important reason is that the underworld used the chaos origin to breed chaos-level treasures to give birth to the fruition position.
The effect of fruit status like this is very obvious, that is, with the addition of fruit status, any living being can easily transform into the most powerful person.
As long as the fruit status is still there, there is no need to worry about the generation of the strong men in the underworld.
Because in the eyes of Yin Tianzi, man will definitely conquer heaven.
No matter how good the treasure is, it is still a dead thing.
Not only could it be lost, but even after all the powerful men fell, the treasure would not be able to exert its corresponding power in hand.
It is precisely in this way that He gathered all the power to give birth to the fruition status.
Such as the Ghost Emperor of the Ten Directions and the Ten Yin Commanders, these are all fruit positions.
The price paid for each fruition position is no less than the cost of nurturing a chaos-level treasure.
From this, it can be seen that the contribution of the underworld to the fruition position is equivalent to at least twenty pieces of chaos-level treasures.
Over the long years, relying on the strong men born in those fruition positions, the underworld can be said to be invincible.
Especially since reincarnation connects all heavens and realms, it can collect endless powerful people.
Under the leadership of those with strong fruit positions, these strong men are even more capable of conquering the heavens.
Yin Tianzi has always been very proud of his plans.
He never expected that he would eventually encounter Sun Bing's Yanhuang Dragon Court.
Relying on the chaos-level treasure, he blocked the underworld's offensive.
At this moment, Yin Tianzi even felt a little regretful. It would have been better if he had not given birth to so many fruitful positions at that time, but had given birth to a few more treasures.
It's a pity that the creatures under the Great Emperor can still start over by reversing time.
Once you break through to the Great Emperor, the past, present and even the future three lives will merge into one.
Any time for these creatures is the present, there is no past, no future, and there is no possibility of looking back.
Unless it is a supreme being in the fifth dimension, it is simply impossible to reverse the past.
However, Yin Tianzi had already made up his mind at this time. After this battle, he would definitely consume the source of chaos and breed some chaos spiritual treasures.
The top priority is to deal with Sun Bing and others first.
This is not just because they threaten the safety of the underworld.
Another very important reason is that as long as Sun Bing and others are killed, does that mean that many treasures such as Qingping Sword and Kaitian Divine Ax can be collected?
Just thinking of such a scene made Yin Tianzi and other beings' hearts full of expectations.
Immediately, He took control of His own authority again.
But Fengdu's hidden will was completely revealed.
"Boom"
Thunder exploded and countless rules were shaken.
The formation that originally restrained the Shura Ghost King was easily broken by the vast chaos.
Two bloody gazes fell directly across the space on Sun Bing.
After being trapped in the formation for such a long time, the murderous intention in Shura Ghost King's heart could not be vented, and now it has reached a level of madness.
So as soon as he got out of trouble, he set his sights on Sun Bing.
Although the Shura Pluto Sword has been swallowed up, the murderous intent on it has soared, and endless bloody murderous intent has gathered in it.
Finally, in full view of everyone, it turned into a killing blade.
This is not a treasure of any level, it is filled with endless killing intent.
Judging from the state of the Shura Ghost King at this time, once this killing blade hurts a living being, the endless killing intent hidden in it will be instantly instilled into the enemy's body.
In the end, he could even use his almost endless killing intent to destroy the enemy's spirit.
Without any words at all, Shura Ghost King took action.
The killing blade was swung out directly.
